title: البتات الكمومية فائقة التوصيل والتماسك
excerpt: دراسة فيزياء الكم والهندسة المبردة حول عدم تناغم البتات الكمومية المرسلة، وتحريض تقاطع جوزيفسون غير الخطي، والتبريد بالتخفيف بمقدار 15 ميليكلفن، وتصحيح الخطأ الكمي للرمز السطحي.
author: Dr. Marcus Vance
imageAlt: Quantum computing cryogenic laboratory and optical laser hardware

Transmon Hamiltonian Formulation:
Ĥ = 4E_C · (n̂ - n_g)² - E_J · cos(φ̂)

Anharmonic Energy Level Separation:
ω_01 = √(8 · E_J · E_C) / ℏ - E_C
ω_12 = ω_01 - E_C
Anharmonicity α = ω_12 - ω_01 = -E_C

Where:
- E_C: Charging energy of the shunt capacitor (e² / 2C)
- E_J: Josephson tunneling energy (I_c · Φ₀ / 2π)
- Transmon Regime Condition: E_J / E_C ≫ 50 (typically 50-100)

items: Phase Separation Boundary: Below 870 mK, liquid ³He and ⁴He mixtures separate into a concentrated phase and a dilute phase.
Endothermic Quantum Evaporation: Pumping ³He atoms across this phase boundary absorbs latent heat, continuously extracting thermal energy from the mixing chamber stage.

Cryogenic Attenuation Lines: Microwave coaxial control lines are fitted with 20dB and 30dB attenuators at each thermal stage to strip room-temperature blackbody thermal noise before it reaches the chip.

items: Surface Preparation: Substrate chemical polishing and atomic trenching under Josephson junctions reduce two-level system dielectric dissipation by over 50%.
Magnetic Shielding: Enclose the cryostat in multilayer high-permeability Mu-metal and superconducting lead canisters to reject stray Earth magnetic flux lines.
Parametric Amplification: Utilize Traveling Wave Parametric Amplifiers (TWPAs) at the 4K stage to achieve quantum-limited readout signal amplification without backaction noise.
